newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady amid sluggish talks.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady amid sluggish talks.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Monday were quoted little changed from Friday's amid a thin market, traders said.
Majors were quoting bunker 180-cst at $127 and 380-cst at $122 with independents indicating at $1-$2 lower.
Traders said the market may edge up if cargo prices increase.
"The market is sluggish on a typical quite Monday," a major told Reuters.
MDO prices were quoted between $210 and $220 and gas oil steady at $225-$235. --Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
